    def include_page(wiki_page, page_name, include_type):
        buffer = []
        page = PageCrawlerImpl.get_inherited_page(page_name, wiki_page)
        if page is not None:
            page_path = page.get_page_crawler().get_full_path(page)
            page_path_name = PathParser.render(page_path)
            buffer.append(f"!include -{include_type} .{page_path_name}\n")
        return buffer
